header_sentences: See Circumcise, Clean, Cleanse, and Wash.

contexts.text: The beginning of purification. Signified. AC 1710. AC 2044.
(How temptations operate in purifying.) AC 1725:2.
After, through combats of temptations, He had purified the Maternal.
It is purer than can be perceived...
That man must first remove his loves... and thus be purified, was represented by circumcision. AC 1986:2. AC 2045.
Purity. Signified.
In proportion as the evils of cupidities and the derivative falsities are removed, in the same proportion man is purified...
For, without the Knowledges of truth, there is never any purification. AC 2046, Explained.
The gentiles can be purified equally with those within the Church; and they are purified when they reject filthy loves, and live together in charity; for they then live in truths. Signified.
Purification from these filthy loves is in the highest degree necessary within the Church; because (such) can render holy things impure.
With man there is no pure intellectual truth...
Their purification and justice from the Lord. Signified, Explained.

The conjunction of the Divine with man cannot take place, unless man is purified from these loves; but, as soon as he is being purified from them, the Divine Human inflows, and conjoins the man with Himself.
That those who have been purified from the loves of self and the world, both within the Church and without it, are justified by the Lord. Signified.
For according to the purification of the ideas (the Angels) are perfected for the reception of heavenly things. That Heaven is not pure before the Lord, is known.
Are infants pure, because they have no actual evil? I was told that they are equally in evil...
Cooked unleavened things = purification. AC 2342:end.
How pure the Word is in the internal sense, although it appears otherwise in the letter.
Blamelessness is expressed in the Hebrew by a word which also means cleanness and purity.
The purification of the Rational. Signified, Explained.

Circumcision represented the purification of the heart... That the heart, that is, the interiors of man, is to be successively and continually purified from the evils of cupidities, and the falsities of the derivative phantasies, is according to Divine order. The precepts concerning the purification of the heart are each and all of Divine order...
(Thus the spiritual man) can scarcely acknowledge any pure truth, such as the celestial acknowledge.
Water to wash his feet = purification there. (Explained.)
To wash with waters = to purify from falsities. Illustrated.

That only external or natural things are to be purified; and unless these have been purified, that is, unless the things of the love of self and of the world have been removed thence, internal things, which are of love to the Lord and towards the neighbour, can never inflow. Example(s). AC 3147:8.
Then the Lord, through these things, purifies also the natural or external man...
The purification of all things which are His in the natural man. Signified, Explained.
The grosser cannot inflow into the purer.
With man there is no pure good, or good not mixed with evil; nor pure truth, or truth not mixed with falsity. Explained.
For example: if anyone believes himself to be pure from sins... if he lives a new life... this is falsity with which good can be mingled...
Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow () = to be purified from sins through the reception and putting on of the Lord's justice.
There are organic forms still purer, which cannot be detected even with the microscope. Explained.
How it is to be understood that Heaven is not pure in the eyes of God (). Explained.

For when man is being purified from these loves, as is the case when he is being regenerated, he is in grief and anxiety. The cupidities which are then being wiped away are what feel grief and anguish.
Thus Spirits are in a body as it were purified.
Purify yourselves, and change your garments () = that holiness is to be put on; (for) to be purified, or cleansed, = to be sanctified.
(Thus) to remove the garments, and put on changes of garments, represented purification from falsities.
For in Heaven there is continual purification, and thus, so to speak, new creation.

Man has no other conception of what is more interior and perfect, than as of what is purer in a continual diminution; but what is purer and grosser may exist in one and the same degree; both according to extension and compression, and according to the determinations; and also according to the insertions of things homogeneous or heterogeneous. Explained. AC 6465:2.

(Thus) with the sensuous things subject to the intellectual part, which are retained. They are not therefore conjoined; for they are not as yet pure from fallacies; but, as they are purified, so they are conjoined.
Souls first come as it were into the region of the stomach, and are there agitated and purified...
The water thus prepared () represented the medium of purification.
The purer blood.
They detain the mind of the other in certain fixed thoughts, whence there rise up and manifest themselves such things as cohere in a series... from which the man is to be purified.
They washed their feet = the purification of the Natural.
How, then, could he see the things which are within even this purer nature?
(Thus) purification, which was represented by the washing of the garments, is effected through the truths of faith.
For the Divine which flowed through the Celestial Kingdom could not be pure, because Heaven is not pure.

The man of the Church who comes into the other life is to be purified from such things as infest truths and goods, otherwise he cannot be elevated into Heaven... Therefore in order that he may be purified, he is kept in a state such that he may be assaulted by scientifics which disagree with truths, and also by falsities; and this until those scientifics become of no account to him, and are removed. This rarely takes place during the life in the body; but it takes place in the other life with those who are to be elevated into Heaven; yet with the greatest variety. (Signified by the Israelites being oppressed by the Egyptians.)
For what is interior, being purer, acts into every single thing of what is exterior.
Internal things are relatively purer and simple.
Evident from the common rule, that with the pure all things are pure, and with the impure all things are impure. Explained.
Natural truth is represented there as a contexture of the purer threads of flax.
The washing of the feet = purification from sins, which is effected through the truths of faith; for by these man is taught how he should live.
Unleavened things = what is purified from all falsity. AC 7902. AC 8058. AC 8060.
For man could not endure pure truth and pure good.
For purifications are effected by fire.

As to truth purified from all falsity, it is to be known that there can never be pure truth with man. Explained... But truth is said to be purified from all falsity, when man can be kept by the Lord in the good of innocence. Innocence is to acknowledge that with himself there is nothing but evil...
It is to be known that the purification of truth from falsity can never come forth without fermentation. Explained.
The state has not as yet been purified when man acts from the truth of faith; but it has been purified when he acts from the good of charity...

Take a bundle of hyssop = an external medium through which is purification... The reason hyssop = external truth which is a medium of purification, is that all spiritual purification is effected through truths; for the earthly and worldly loves from which man is to be purified are not Known except through truths. When these are insinuated by the Lord, horror is insinuated at the same time for these loves, which causes that when the like inflows into the thought, that horror returns, and consequently aversion for them. Thus is man purified through truths, as through external media.
When they had been delivered from the Lower Earth... they were brought into a second state of purification, which is that of temptations.
Therefore with the man (of the Spiritual Church) the good of truth cannot long remain pure...
White... = that the truth therein was pure. Explained.
Because the truths are pure without a worldly end. Signified, Explained.
Good cannot be conjoined with truths until the truths have been purified from falsities of evil.
The purification of truths. Signified.
The purification of the good of faith. Signified, Explained.
Those who, as to the interiors, are not in good and truth, cannot be in pure marriage...
At the end of the purification. Signified.
Purification from that evil because done from immoderate zeal... Signified.
Purifications from these loves are impossible except through the truths of faith, because these teach that all concupiscences are from these loves.
For the man who is being regenerated is first purified from falsities... AC 9294:2, Explained.
Worship and thanksgiving on account of purification from falsities. Signified.
To purify the sons of Levi... () = the purification of good and truth...
Man is not purified from sins; but is withheld from them...
The purification and withdrawal from evils and falsities through truths and goods from the Word. Signified.
The snuffers, etc. = things purificatory and evacuatory in the Natural. Signified.
All things of the internal man descend into the Natural, and are purified. Why this is done in the Natural.
Washing = the purification of the internal man.

The bullock and ram = the purification of good from evils in the external and internal man. (AC 9990.) That this purification was effected through truths from good. Signified. And the he-goat, etc. = the purification of truth from falsities in the external man.
Pure, when said of the good sig. by the oil, = genuine. Explained.
The purifications commanded for the priests. Enumerated, Explained.
Pure gold () = good from the Divine.

All the expiation effected by the washings, sacrifices, etc., represented the purification of the heart from evils and falsities, thus regeneration; and (this) purification is effected through the truths of faith. Signified. AC 9990.

Before man can be regenerated, he must be purified from evils and falsities... The purifications of the external man were represented by the sacrifices from oxen, bullocks, and he-goats; the purifications of the internal man, by those from rams, kids, and she-goats; and the purification of the internal itself, which is inmost, by those from lambs (and kids). AC 9991. AC 10042:8.
Unleavened bread = the purification of the Celestial in the inmost man.
Unleavened cakes... = the purification of the middle Celestial.
Purification through the truths of faith. Signified.
The application of the natural man for purification... Signified. AC 10022.
For when man has been purified from evils and falsities, which is effected through their removal, then inflow good and truth from the Lord, and... they are conjoined. (Not otherwise.)
Preparation for the purification of good and truth from the Lord in the external man. Signified, Explained.
All purification is effected through the Divine truth proceeding from the Divine good. Explained.
When man is being purified, he first of all learns such truths as can be apprehended by the sensuous man. Signified, Explained.
All things of worship relate to purification from evils and falsities, etc. Explained.
The purification of the whole man, external, internal, and inmost. Representation.
The purification of the lowest things. Signified, Explained.
Therefore the purification of the internal man... is effected in Heaven by the Lord.
The purification of the exterior things of the natural man. Signified, Explained.

With the man who is being regenerated, purification from evils and falsities continually goes on; for in proportion as man is purified from evils and falsities, in the same proportion are implanted the truths of faith, and these are conjoined with the good of charity, and in the same proportion the man afterwards acts from the good of charity. (AC 10127:4.) The purification from evils and falsities with man, is not deliverance from them; but is their removal. References.
The appropriation of good with those who have been purified from evils and falsities. Signified.
Purification from evils in Heaven and in the Church. Signified, Explained.
To propitiate = purification from evils and the derivative falsities; or, what is the same, their removal.
The meat-offerings = purification from evils; and all purification from evils is effected in a state of the good of innocence. Signified.
For purification from evils and falsities is to desist from them, and to shun and be averse to them.
Purification from evils through the truths of faith which are from the good of love. Signified, Explained.
For nothing of man has been purified, unless the extremes have been purified. Signified, Explained.
All purification from evils lasts perpetually, not only in the world, but also (there). Signified.
Hence man can never be purified from evils unless he is in the good of innocence. Explained.
Purification from evils is nothing but detention from them, that is, their removal.
Purification or deliverance from evil through the faith that all truths and goods... are from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
The purifying truths from good of the Church. Signified, Explained.
How truths are the sole means of man's purification. Explained.
The new thing here expounded is concerning purification from evils and falsities.
The laver of brass = the good of the natural man in which there is purification, Explained. AC 10237.

Both the internal and the external of man are purified; the internal in Heaven, and the external while he lives (here), thus in the Natural. The reason purification then goes on in the Natural, is that the truths of faith in the Natural come to manifest perception.

That purification is effected through truths, is evident from the fact that those who are being purified must not only know what is evil and false, but also acknowledge, and then be averse to and shun it. Then, first, is man purified from them.
A representative of the purification... of man by the Lord. Signified, Explained.
Regeneration differs from purification in this: that regeneration is the precedent, and purification is the consequent. Explained.
Purification through the truths of faith. Signified.
For unless the Natural is purified in the world, it cannot be purified afterwards to eternity.
All things which are of purification... Signified.
Pure frankincense (). Explained. AC 10296:3.
Pure () = without evil.
For interior things are in themselves purer.
A dove = purification... through Divine truth.
To purify the interiors, which are of the will and thought... through the Word... that so the exteriors may be purified, which are of works and speech. Signified.
The sun pure fire. DLW 90:end. DLW 157. DLW 351. DLW 353. DP 3:2. TCR 41, AE 944:2. AE 1218:2. (See Fire at LJPost 321.)
No communication by continuity, that is, as of purer and grosser...
That the will is purified in the understanding. General article.
For all the purification of man is through the truths which are of wisdom...
That the love purified by wisdom in the understanding becomes spiritual and celestial. General article.

(Thus) with him who is spiritual, it is the purer blood... which has been purified; and it is purified in proportion as the man is in the marriage of love and wisdom... And, as the purer blood inflows into the blood of the body, it follows that this is purified through it.
The purer anything is, the fuller it is.
That evil and falsity are made to serve for purification, etc. General article.
(This) purification is effected in two ways: by temptations, and by fermentations. Explained.
That the Internal cannot be purified from the concupiscences of evil, so long as the evils in the external man have not been removed. General article.
That the Lord then purifies man from concupiscences in the internal man, and from the evils themselves in the external. General article.
So long as the ultimates are kept closed by the man himself, there cannot be any purification. Explained. DP 120:2.

Many believe that merely believing... purifies man from evils; some that doing good purifies; some, knowing, saying, and teaching the things of the Church; some, reading the Word and pious books; some, frequenting places of worship, hearing preachings, and especially approaching the Holy Supper; some, renouncing the world and devoting one's self to piety; some, confessing one's self guilty of all sins; and so on. But these do not purify man at all, unless he explores himself, sees his sins, acknowledges them, condemns himself on account of them, and does repentance by desisting from them...
That the internal man must first be purified, and thus the external, is known. Illustrated, Explained.

Purification from evils. Signified. To purify the internal man... to purify the external man... and that when the internal man has been purified, the external must be purified... and that all purification from evils is from the Lord. Signified. AE 666:2.
At death, man retains the purer things of nature...
Some men after death believe that they are pure from sins... They are first clothed in white garments, which = a state purified from evils...
Substances purely organic.

On the methods by which man is withdrawn from evil... The delights of concupiscences... are emitted into the interior thoughts... and thence into the exterior thoughts... The means of purification, etc., are there. Described.

With an evil man there is no other purification... than of the more grievous evils... But with a good man there is (also) the purification of the less grievous ones; and this is effected through the delights of the affections of good and truth... These are the means by which the Lord purifies all who are saved. He also purifies the same by external means, which belong to fame and honour...
Comparison with the purification of the blood in the body.
(Thus) the Divine Providence... is constant in its end to purify man.
That they had purified their (religious things) from the falsities of evil by truths. Signified, Explained.
A Sun which is pure love; and a sun which is pure fire. TCR 75:2. TCR 76:2. TCR 76:4. TCR 77:3.
That they will be instructed in truths genuine and pure... Signified.
The prior, being in itself purer...
That love truly conjugial is... purer than any other love. Explained.
With men, or Angels, no love can ever become pure; but, as the intention of the will is primarily regarded by the Lord, in proportion as man is in this... he is initiated into its purity... CL 146.
Thus the purity of conjugial love is what is called chastity.
That with those who become spiritual, conjugial love is more and more purified. Explained.
This spiritual purification compared to the purification of natural spirits. Explained.
Thus the natural sun is mere fire; and also is fire in its own purity itself. ISB 10.

That the Divine virtue and operation meant by the Holy Spirit are... renewal, vivification, sanctification, and justification; and, according to these, purification from evils. General article. TCR 149.
Purification from evils is the remission of sins.
For baptism = regeneration and purification; in like manner a dove.

That man must purify himself from evils, and not wait for the Lord to do it immediately. Shown... The Lord would say. The means of purification are from Me... Use them, and you will be purified. TCR 436:2.
But no one can purify himself from evils by his Own power... but still it cannot be done without the man's power, as if his Own. Explained.
(Thus) the thought is the Purificatory... of (the hereditary) evils.
That baptism means spiritual washing, which is purification from evils and falsities, and thus regeneration. General article.
That agitations and thus purifications (there) are innumerable. Explained.
What a purified body is.
See Last Judgment.
(The methods used in the purifications of the Reformed.) 5839[2].
When a Society began to be infected... it was purified in various ways.
The kidneys = the truths of faith, and their purification from falsities. Explained.
Pure in heart () = those who are in good from love.
Hyssop = an external means of purification.
That both the internal and the external man are to be purified; and the external through the internal. (References to passages.)
The internal man is purified through the truths which are of faith; and the external through a life according to them. Signified.
Man cannot be purified from evils and falsities, unless the unclean things which are in him emerge into the thought...
A coal from the altar = the Divine love, from which is all purification.
This may be illustrated by the idea of a surface, in the middle of which are things purer...
The brazen sea represented the common Purificatory...
When Societies are being purified...
That the interior of man must be purified, before the good he does is good. Signified. The interior of man is purified solely by desisting from evils according to the commandments...
(Thus) the love of marriage even in its ultimate act is purity itself... and the love of adultery in its acts is impurity itself.
Wonderful to say, the purer things (in nature) are in the grosser...
3. That the life of the understanding purifies the life of the will. Explained.
As is the mind of the head in (the fibres, etc.) such are the delights: pure, or impure...
